votes.motion: Council Member Prokopis, seconded by Council Member Peel, moved to close the staff meeting and go into the public meeting
Council Member Peel, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to approve Resolution 19-06-02

Council Member Prokopis, seconded by Council Member Peel, moved to approve the fee waiver for $2,150 for the 2018 fees imposed on the Cyprus-Ute Football Program for the DATE TUESDAY JUNE 25, 2019 August 25, 2019 and October 17, 2019 use of the Magna-Copper Park
Council Member Peel, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to set the date of Tuesday July 9, 2019, at 7:30 p.m., to accept public comment and consider Ordinance No. 19-06-01
